schema.name: idx_ppv1_budget_run
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_budget_run
    ON budget_reservations (run_id, limit_key, scope, status)

schema.name: idx_ppv1_commit_action
schema.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_ppv1_commit_action
    ON search_commit_records (action_id)

schema.name: idx_ppv1_events_run
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_events_run
    ON events (run_id, parent_path_id)

schema.name: idx_ppv1_hyp_parent
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_hyp_parent
    ON hypotheses (parent_path_id)

schema.name: idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_actions_run
    ON search_actions (run_id, status)

schema.name: idx_ppv1_search_attempts_action
schema.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_ppv1_search_attempts_action
    ON search_attempts (action_id)

schema.name: budget_reservations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE budget_reservations (
    reservation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    limit_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    units         INTEGER NOT NULL,
    action_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    settled_at    TEXT
)

schema.name: endpoint_records
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE endpoint_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema.name: event_appearance_links
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE event_appearance_links (
    event_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    state_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (event_id, state_id, appearance_hash)
)

schema.name: events
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE events (
    event_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id             TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id     TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash       TEXT NOT NULL,
    event_semantics_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload            TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (run_id, parent_path_id, hypothesis_id, context_hash,
            event_semantics_hash)
)

schema.name: expansion_plans
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE expansion_plans (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: hypotheses
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE hypotheses (
    hypothesis_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    context_hash   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload        TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at     TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: meta
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE meta (
    key   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: model_requests
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE model_requests (
    request_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    provider_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    purpose      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    network_request_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    response_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    retry_of     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema.name: provenance_records
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE provenance_records (
    record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: report_projections
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE report_projections (
    event_id  TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload   TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: search_actions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE search_actions (
    action_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_path_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    context_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    action_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_search_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    policy_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    budget_reservation_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    attempt_refs TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    defer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    claimed_at   TEXT,
    claimed_by   TEXT,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

schema.name: search_attempts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE search_attempts (
    expansion_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    hypothesis_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    attempt_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reopen_of    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    status       TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome_ref  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at  TEXT
)

schema.name: search_commit_records
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE search_commit_records (
    commit_id    TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    run_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    action_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_id   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    event_id     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    commit_kind  TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: search_runs
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE search_runs (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_block TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: state_appearances
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE state_appearances (
    state_id    TEXT NOT NULL,
    appearance_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload     TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (state_id, appearance_hash)
)

schema.name: states
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE states (
    state_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload    TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
)

schema.name: stop_reason_records
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE stop_reason_records (
    run_id       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    payload      TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at   TEXT
)

manifest.determinism_note: payload/manifest 无时间戳;canonical_json 键序 + 列表稳定排序;export_digest = content_hash(本 manifest 去掉 export_digest 键);同事实+同版本+同策略 ⇒ 同字节

graph_facts.note: PPV1 graph revision 等价身份 = 持久事实表逐表内容 digest(legacy 整数 graph_revision 不适用;任何行变化 ⇒ 旧导出 stale)

alternatives.note: 同父备选反应各自独立(不合并为单反应;A01);不同来路/parent/context 不按 CN 全局合并

reasons: R5:unknown_checks_present(不自动拒绝;可有界探索可能路径,继承未解决依赖;未知步长不进确认单步指标):participant_completeness,element_accounting,formal_charge_accounting,step_scope_check,condition_check

reasons: R5:unknown_checks_present(不自动拒绝;可有界探索可能路径,继承未解决依赖;未知步长不进确认单步指标):participant_completeness,element_accounting,formal_charge_accounting,transformation_center,step_scope_check,condition_check

checks.name: transformation_center
checks.reason_code: center_evidence_coverage_unknown_coefficients(参与物系数未知:覆盖与贡献规模不可算,不得计入全部核实;系数须已知或另行补全,不冒充已覆盖)

coproducts.note: 完整事件保留共同产物(不被报告 K/展开宽度截断)

endpoint_record.assessment_note: 评估只由独立终点证据决定(来源层直报;模型预测/路径推断不能单独产生 supported_*;停止原因永不映射为终点(F01);存在未解决必要依赖时评估保持 unknown(F02);当前路线已引入的必要条件 unknown/conflict 同样保持 unknown(S4-C01,同源 route_assessment;已知兼容正控不受影响));metabolic_handoff 不等于矿化;supported_terminal_transformation_product 不推断永久去除

bookkeeping.note: 账目闭合只表示声明范围内账面闭合(参与物/系数引用完整),不等于发生矿化,也不等于生物可行;不同备选反应生成的 CO₂ 不相加(逐事件/逐备选列示,运行级聚合不产生);root carbon accounting coverage 只表示核查范围,不表示所有根碳已转化;单项 CO₂ 产物不自动解释为根污染物矿化

conditions_snapshot.note: 条件事实快照(来路/评估权威在 PathContext;此处只采计数,不重评估、不把未知条件判缺席

derived_from.derived_note: 重算输入摘要;stop 报告含会话 refusals 不可无会话复算,以持久 stop 记录行 hash 作跨表一致性核对

endpoint_evidence_source.note: 证据声明为冻结计划输入(S3B-01 冻结来源);来源层直报,不代表本仓已核实来源真实性

evidence_summary.dedup_note: F03 去重口径 = 观察身份(来源引用集合 + basis + 声明 + 窗口/检测/条件)与来源身份(来源引用集合);来路不删除,全部原始条目保留在 endpoint_evidence;同一来源多个引用/同一观察多个包装不增加独立支持

contexts.source: PathContext.route_assessment(历史快照逐边合取 + 当前阶段 live;旧边按记录值消费,不重评)

route_condition_assessment.note: 当前路线必要条件评估(同源 PathContext.route_assessment:历史快照逐边合取 + 当前阶段 live;旧边按记录值消费,不拿当前事实重评);必要条件存在 unknown/conflict ⇒ 终点保持 unknown(证据全文保留,不被 recorded 或充分字段洗白);已知兼容/无必要条件不构成阻断(不全拒);条件评估权威在 PathContext,此处只消费同源结果,不解析自由文本、不新增化学门

search_stop_reason.note: 搜索停止是执行事实,独立持久化于 stop_reason_records;停止原因不映射为化学终点(F01)

unexplored.note: 停止不是化学终点;存在 deferred/知识缺口时不称“所有路线都探索完”;claimed/open attempt 是仍在执行的未完成工作,存在时不报 exhausted_search

detail.note: 检索/池无候选;不反证上游;按稳定次序继续可用备选
检索/池无候选;不反证上游;按稳定次序继续可用备选
检索/池无候选;不反证上游;按稳定次序继续可用备选

generated_at_basis.note: 生成依据:store SQLite 行 + artifact store(H07 完整性包装)读取;确定性规范化 = canonical_json 键序 + 列表稳定排序;载荷不含构建时间戳(同事实⇒ 同 digest;artifact 信封 created_at 记录落盘时刻);正式文件导出/manifest/读取消费契约属 S4b

driver_session.note: flock 是执行权权威;崩溃 OS 自动释放

native_export.note: S4b 正式文件导出(全量事实 + manifest 新鲜度锚);读取/消费走 read_native_export(首消费:missing/corrupt/version/policy/stale/reference 拒)

native_result.note: S4a 对象底座:完整字段 + 确定性规范化(同事实同 digest);正式文件导出见 native_export

unexplored.note: 停止不是化学终点;存在 deferred/知识缺口时不称“所有路线都探索完”;claimed/open attempt 是仍在执行的未完成工作,存在时不报 exhausted_search

v3_projection.note: v3 有损投影(lossy_projection;原生引用 + 信息损失清单);反向消费禁止 —— 不得从投影改写原生事实/事件;读取走 read_v3_projection
